write_up: You’ve moved from Department Supervisor to Store Manager at Carolina Home & Garden, and your recent work shows both the business you run and the changes you’ve made. The open question is your headline: it promises two store turnarounds, but the bullets show detailed results for only the Charlotte store.

The fixed-schedule line is your model. It connects a management decision to a before-and-after turnover figure, so a recruiter can see what you changed. Your promotion history and dates are easy to follow, too.

Start with the two-turnaround claim. Add what changed at each store and your part in it, or narrow the headline to the work you can show. The sales and shrink lines already give you strong material to build around.
